reviewer.description: The lens that produced this output, e.g. 'coherence', 'feasibility', 'product-lens'

findings.description: The lens's findings. An empty array when it found no issue.

title.description: Short, specific issue title, 10 words or fewer.

severity.description: P0 immediate critical harm; P1 prevents a required outcome or causes substantial harm or rework; P2 a worthwhile localized correction; P3 a useful advisory concern.

section.description: The document section where the issue appears, named so a reader without the document can tell what it is: 'U1 - Establish profile contracts', not 'U1'. A plain section name needs no handle.

why_it_matters.description: What goes wrong if this is not addressed, consequence first, in 2 to 4 sentences.

autofix_class.description: safe_auto: a mechanical correction with one right answer that follows from authoritative text in the document. gated_auto: a concrete correction to the document's meaning for the agreed outcome; several workable technical approaches do not by themselves need a user decision. manual: an unresolved user choice, or essential information no investigation can obtain. Synthesis decides edit authority.

finding_type.description: error: incorrect or incompatible instructions. omission: a necessary decision or constraint that the document, its references and the existing conventions do not supply. Missing repetition or optional detail is no omission.

suggested_fix.description: One committed fix, never a menu of alternatives. Omit or null when no good fix is obvious: a bad suggestion is worse than none.

confidence.description: Anchored confidence, exactly one of 0, 25, 50, 75, 100. 0: a false positive, or a pre-existing issue the document did not introduce. 25: might be real, but the lens could not verify it. 50: the lens verified a useful advisory concern below the actionable bar and can state its concrete benefit; a nit without that benefit is suppressed, not routed to FYI. 75: the lens double-checked it, and following the document will produce a wrong outcome, block execution or cause material rework. 100: the evidence directly confirms it and leaves no room for another reading.

evidence.description: Direct quotes from the document that support the finding. At least 1.

residual_risks.description: Distinct uncertainty with evidence of a material consequence for the agreed outcome, held to the same standard as findings: no rejected claims, preferences or successful verifications.

deferred_questions.description: Essential information or decisions a later stage must settle to deliver the agreed outcome. Omit questions the document or discoverable project evidence already answers.
